boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Florida Atlantic University
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe food runs across Boca Raton, ranging from walkable Glades Road stops to after-midnight drive-throughs.

cards.title: Cross Glades for a Midnight Shack Stop
cards.subtitle: University Commons, directly south of FAU
cards.notes: Walk or ride south across Glades Road for burgers, fries, or frozen custard; use extra care at the major road crossing after dark.
cards.short_summary: The closest documented midnight food stop sits just across Glades Road from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s official location page lists 1400 Glades Road and closing times of midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Shake Shack at 1400 Glades Road Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Open until 12 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; official page lists dine-in, pickup, and delivery.

cards.entity_name: Ramen Lab Eatery – East Boca Raton
cards.title: Make a Late Ramen Run Downtown
cards.subtitle: East Boca Raton near Mizner Park
cards.notes: Head east for ramen, rice dishes, or boba; Friday and Saturday provide the latest window, while weekday service ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A downtown noodle counter extends the evening beyond most sit-down dinner schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramen Lab Eatery’s official locations page lists the East Boca restaurant at 100 NE 2nd Street and hours through 11:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 11:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday, and 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Take the Mizner Park Noodle Route
cards.subtitle: Mizner Park in downtown Boca Raton
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s direct ordering page to confirm the nightly pickup window before leaving; Friday and Saturday run latest.
cards.short_summary: Mizner Park adds a late Asian-fusion option to the campus-to-downtown circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: Kapow’s direct Toast ordering page identifies 402 Plaza Real and lists pickup through 11:45 p.m. Friday and Saturday and 10:45 p.m. other nights.
cards.access_notes: Pickup hours run to 10:45 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:45 p.m. Friday–Saturday on the direct ordering page.

cards.title: Use Federal Highway for the 3 A.M. Window
cards.subtitle: East Boca Raton on North Federal Highway
cards.notes: Choose this drive-through when the downtown kitchens have closed; verify the restaurant-hour panel before setting out late.
cards.short_summary: This Federal Highway counter maintains one of Boca Raton’s clearest daily after-midnight schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists its 865 N Federal Highway restaurant and drive-through as open until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 865 N Federal Hwy in Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are 9 a.m.–3 a.m. daily according to the official location page.

cards.title: Carry Out Pizza Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: North Federal Highway in downtown Boca Raton
cards.notes: Order before departure and choose carryout or delivery; the official schedule currently keeps both channels open equally late.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza storefront offers a consistent 2 a.m. option every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns’ official location page lists 505 N Federal Highway with delivery and carryout available until 2 a.m. seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns N Federal Hwy | Papa Johns Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are listed from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Keep the Diner Option in Reserve
cards.subtitle: West Palmetto Park Road, south of FAU
cards.notes: Use this all-hours diner when the night has moved beyond ordinary dinner service; walk-ins and takeout are both documented.
cards.short_summary: Round-the-clock diner service provides an indoor alternative to late drive-throughs.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official restaurant page identifies 1311 W Palmetto Park Road and states that the restaurant is open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Denny's | 1311 West Palmetto Park Rd | Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily; the official page also lists walk-ins and takeout among its services.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell – 1361 W Palmetto Park Road
cards.title: Follow the 5 A.M. Drive-Through Clock
cards.subtitle: Beside the all-night diner on Palmetto Park Road
cards.notes: Treat this primarily as a drive-through run after midnight; the posted dine-in schedule is much shorter than vehicle service.
cards.short_summary: The Palmetto Park drive-through covers the deepest part of the overnight schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists the 1361 W Palmetto Park Road drive-through until 5 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 5:30 a.m. Friday, and continuously on weekends.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me in Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 5 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 5:30 a.m. Friday, and is listed open 24 hours Saturday–Sunday; dine-in ends at midnight.

cards.title: Stay on Glades Road Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: West Boca Raton along the campus’s main east–west road
cards.notes: Continue west on Glades Road for a straightforward late drive-through; check the official page because this is not walkable from campus.
cards.short_summary: A same-corridor option extends late food access far west of the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page for 9192-A Glades Road lists restaurant and drive-through hours until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s Kids’ Meals at 9192-A Glades Road in Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are listed as 10 a.m.–2 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Use Sandalfoot for the Near-All-Night Run
cards.subtitle: Far west Boca Raton near Glades Road and US 441
cards.notes: Save this distant drive-through for a planned vehicle trip; indoor service ends at midnight even though the lane continues overnight.
cards.short_summary: West Boca’s overnight drive-through has the board’s latest posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists the Sandalfoot Plaza drive-through until 4–5:30 a.m., with Saturday service spanning nearly 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Boca Raton, FL – 22953 Sandalfoot Plaza Drive
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 4 a.m. Sunday, 5 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 5:30 a.m. Friday, and 5:29 a.m. Saturday; dine-in is listed only through midnight Sunday.

cards.title: Take Glades Road to an All-Night Booth
cards.subtitle: West Boca Raton near US 441 and Glades Road
cards.notes: Plan for a longer drive west from campus, then use dine-in or takeout; the official listing documents continuous daily service.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours pancake house anchors the far western end of Boca Raton’s late-night route.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official restaurant page lists 10050 Calle Comercio in Boca Raton as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast in Boca Raton, FL on 10050 Calle Comercio
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours every day; the official page lists dine-in, takeout, delivery, and curbside pickup.
